introduction.title: Functions
introduction.explanation: Give a set of moves a name, then use the name anywhere.

realWords.text: A function is a set of instructions with a name. The word function, then the name, then the lines in curly brackets: that is defining it. Writing the name with round brackets, like hop(), is calling it.
Some functions hand back an answer when they finish, and the word after the colon says what kind. void means nothing: this function does its job and hands nothing back.
